svg.title: The measurement
svg.desc: bench/memory.py starts a daemon under a throwaway profile. One agent opens a tab and takes a snapshot every 10 seconds for the whole run, which keeps the daemon busy as on a real Mac. Each of the other agents opens a heavy page in a tab of its own, takes a snapshot, clicks and reads the text, and never comes back. The heavy page holds memory the way a web app does: a JavaScript heap, a typed array, a drawn canvas, decoded images and a few thousand DOM nodes, kept busy by an animation and a timer. Every 5 seconds the bench adds up the physical footprint (Activity Monitor's Memory column) and CPU time of the daemon and of every process macOS holds it responsible for: its web content, GPU and networking processes. UMBRA_IDLE is 60 seconds here so a run takes minutes rather than an hour.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Display', 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
